newsitem.title: USA: Kodak develops camera for police use.
newsitem.headline: Kodak develops camera for police use.

text.p: Eastman Kodak Co said Friday it has developed a sturdy camera designed for one-time-use by police patrol officers. The Kodak Flash Response camera equips patrol officers to easily document domestic violence calls, minor crime scenes, automobile accidents, suspicious fires and other activities.
The company said these cameras have been field-tested by the New York City and Los Angeles Police Departments, among others.
Because some new state laws require photographic evidence in domestic violence cases, on-site photography can be critical, said Kodak.
With 15 exposures, these cameras are designed to be used at one or possibly two crime scenes, then turned in for processing, the company said.
